name: omnilab/swpc
description: Omnilab SWPC: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center - the probability of an aurora overhead at a point (OVATION's nowcast) as a series, and outside the contract, space weather not being at a place on the Earth, the planetary Kp index observed and predicted, the solar wind at L1 (speed, density, temperature, Bt, Bz), the alerts, warnings and watches, and the NOAA scales; through SWPC's public JSON files, no key needed.
